title: Stress in the workplace
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What part of work creates the most harmful stress: workload, uncertainty, people, lack of control, or something else?
Should employees be expected to answer messages after working hours?
How can a manager notice stress before an employee reaches burnout?
Would a four-day workweek reduce stress in your type of work, or simply compress the same workload?
What workplace change would reduce stress without reducing performance?
